name: Woodpecker Status
description: Shows the status of all your Woodpecker CI projects in the sidebar, with error messages and a log excerpt of the failed step. Read-only: talks only to your own Woodpecker server, no tracking.

settings.title: Woodpecker URL
settings.description: Address of your Woodpecker instance. The token is entered in the panel and stored encrypted.
